description: NaSS crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅42d space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.81-3.19 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.87-3.05 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one S atom. The S-S bond length is 2.07 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two S atoms. The S-S bond length is 2.05 Å.
